svg.title: Repository layout
svg.desc: Repository layout, from the directory listing to depth three. client/ Go client for the HTTP API. cmd/ Executable entry points. cmd/quarry-mcp/ Local MCP server over stdio. cmd/server/ Wiring and graceful shutdown. docs/ Service documentation. docs/diagrams/ Architecture, schema and layout. docs/diagrams/src/ Diagram placement sources. internal/ Private service packages. internal/api/ HTTP router. internal/api/handler/ Request handlers. internal/api/middleware/ Authentication, logs and metrics. internal/awsconf/ AWS credentials and retry policy. internal/chunker/ Text windows and fingerprints. internal/cleanup/ Document deletion across stores. internal/config/ Configuration and validation. internal/domain/ Shared types and interfaces. internal/embedder/ Titan V2 and offline embeddings. internal/extractor/ File parsing and process isolation. internal/llm/ Answer routing and Converse. internal/logctx/ Request log attributes. internal/metrics/ Prometheus text metrics. internal/pipeline/ Ingestion and query stages. internal/retriever/ LOCAL and GLOBAL retrieval. internal/store/ Storage adapters. internal/store/memory/ Offline vector index. internal/store/pinecone/ Hosted vector index. internal/store/postgres/ Documents, chunks and durable jobs. internal/store/s3/ Original files and signed downloads. internal/testutil/ Test support. internal/testutil/pgtest/ Disposable database containers. internal/textutil/ Unicode normalization. internal/tracing/ OpenTelemetry export and span helpers. internal/worker/ Leased ingestion and retry handling. scripts/ Operational commands. scripts/cleanup/ Delete selected documents. scripts/langeval/ Answer language and latency checks. scripts/reconcile/ Find and remove orphan vectors. scripts/simulate/ Exercise the service API. scripts/validate/ Check retrieval behavior. test/ Service test suites. test/integration/ Database and API integration. test/smoke/ Opt-in live service checks. test/unit/ Package behavior checks. tools/ Documentation support. tools/diagrams/ Vector image sources and checks. tools/diagrams/fonts/ Bundled typefaces and license. The highlight follows cmd/server, internal/api, internal/pipeline, internal/retriever, internal/llm and internal/store.
